decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans 2356-01/MT, 2356-02/MT, 2356-03/MT  submitted 12/08/2011  therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - No additional flank windows or doors other glazed openings shall be formed in the flank wall or front wall of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
description: Erection of a two storey side extension to the house
